gate.check: Source ledger written, REQ table frozen, carry-over ledger seeded, autonomy sweep covered, operator confirms the brief.
Every external API shape and every carried claim is checked against a primary source. Anything that fails to verify goes to carry-over, never into references (CONTRIBUTING.md: evidence or silence).
Module map committed; every REQ in exactly one module; no two parallel modules own the same file; walking skeleton first.
docs/superpowers/specs/ amended: Script contract covers every new script and every new finding code; contracts locked before any code.
Per-module task list with TDD order; each task names its file paths, its test and its definition of done.
Failing test first, minimal implementation, green, conventional commit per task. stdlib-only holds for every script.
python3 test/validate.py && python3 test/test_page_audit.py both pass; every new doctrine guard is proved by watching it FAIL against a planted defect before it is trusted.
CI negative self-tests still fail as designed; no Python bytecode in the tree; npm tarball clean.
No deploy this run by operator decision: branch to main, release deferred to carry-over CO-2.
Every source-ledger row updated: CONTRIBUTING.md and the spec lose the nineteen-references drift, README counts corrected, DOCMAP propagation matrix walked, wiki synced, graph refreshed where built.

Ladder walk per REQ (decision to spec to contract and its failure behaviour to task to change to executed test to surface/docs); absences become new REQ rows before the coverage table is written; carry-over counts printed beside the verdict; retro pruned, stamped and written.
